name: Intercom Fin
summary: Intercom's AI customer agent for service, sales and e-commerce, billed per resolved outcome.
description: Fin is Intercom's AI agent for customer service, also configured for sales, e-commerce and customer success. It answers across chat, email and voice, follows company procedures and works with helpdesks including Intercom, Zendesk and Salesforce. Pricing is $0.99 per outcome, with an option bundling the Intercom helpdesk from $19 per seat per month; a 14-day free trial is offered. More than 12,000 companies use Fin, according to the site.
